newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bank of China FRCD issue 4.5 times oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Bank of China FRCD issue 4.5 times oversubscribed.

text.p: Bank of China Hong Kong branch's floating rate certificate of deposit issue has been 4.5 times oversubscribed, Bank of China said on Monday.

"According to our preliminary counting, there are more than 60 financial institutions who have committed a total participation amount of over HK$9 billion, 4.5 times our issued amount," Bank of China said.
The five-year FRCD pays a margin of 35 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate and, with fees, an all-in return of 41.5 basis points to top-tier participants.
It was launched on September 16 with an initial amount of HK$2 billion.
Moody's Investors Service today assigned the issue a rating of Baa1, a rating that the Bank of China said it received with "regret."
"We are of the opinion that Moody's ratings are unfair and not objective," the bank said in a release.
